Blockbusters est un podcast consacré au: Blockbusters is a podcast about popular cinema and pop culture. It analyses big-screen spectacles, Hollywood franchises and the cultural phenomena that make headlines at the box office. A format that unashamedly embraces its love of commercial cinema.
L'émission de France Inter animée par Fr: France Inter's show hosted by Frédérick Sigrist, devoted to popular culture in all its forms. From films to TV series, by way of Victor Hugo and 19th-century crazes, each episode dissects what makes a work connect with the general public. Sadly discontinued, but the archives remain a timeless goldmine. Our verdict: a gem of French pop culture, sometimes frustrating because too episodic, but a valuable sociological dive. Start with the themes that speak to you — you won't leave empty-handed.
